hints.title: Prerequisite Bitmask Validation
hints.text: For each node, compute a bitmask representing all predecessor nodes that must precede it in any valid topological order.

hints.title: Subset Construction
hints.text: Track the maximum profit for each subset of scheduled nodes using a table indexed by subset masks.

hints.title: Position Weighted Transitions
hints.text: The next placed node occupies position equal to the current subset size plus one, scaling its score accordingly.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: number of vertices in the DAG
complexity.notes: Bitmask dynamic programming iterates over 2^N states with N transitions per state.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining all N! permutations takes factorial time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Exponential DP table bounds state space to 2^N entries.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Formulate DP over topological order bitmasks with predecessor validation.
